section.content: 本实用新型涉及基因检测技术领域，一种生物基因检测探针，包括探针外壳，所述探针外壳的内部活动连接有活动块，所述活动块的底部接触连接有安装块，所述安装块的内部固定连接有探针本体，所述探针外壳的内部设置有伸缩机构，所述伸缩机构包括与探针外壳内壁固定连接的电机，所述电机的输出轴固定连接有螺杆，所述螺杆的外侧螺纹连接有一端贯穿并延伸至固定板底部的滑杆。该生物基因检测探针，通过设置伸缩机构，使得在电机和螺杆的作用下，可以将探针本体进行伸出和收回，在安装好探针本体后可以将探针本体收回探针外壳内部，从而防止探针本体被外力损坏，通过电机，可以对探针本体采集工作起到帮助。

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field, a biological gene detection probe, including the probe shell, the inside swing joint of probe shell has the movable block, the bottom contact of movable block is connected with the installation piece, the inside fixedly connected with probe body of installation piece, the inside of probe shell is provided with telescopic machanism, telescopic machanism include with probe shell inner wall fixed connection's motor, the output shaft fixedly connected with screw rod of motor, the outside threaded connection of screw rod has one end to run through and extend to the slide bar of fixed plate bottom. This biological gene detection probe is through setting up telescopic machanism for under the effect of motor and screw rod, can stretch out and withdraw the probe body, can withdraw the probe body inside the probe shell after installing the probe body, thereby prevent that the probe body from being damaged by external force, through the motor, can play help to probe body collection work.

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection technical field specifically is a biological gene detection probe.

Background

The gene is a genetic basic unit, a DNA or RNA sequence carrying genetic information is copied to transmit the genetic information to the next generation, and synthesis of protein is guided to express the genetic information carried by the gene, so that the character expression of an organism individual is controlled.

When the existing detection probe is not used, the probe body is protected by a plastic sleeve, so that the protection effect can be achieved, but when external force is large, the probe body in the plastic sleeve can be damaged, and therefore, the biological gene detection probe is provided to solve the problems.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a biological gene detection probe possesses advantages such as flexible probe, has solved when the exogenic action is great, and the problem of damage may take place for the probe body in the plastic sheath.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, includes the probe shell, the inside sliding connection of probe shell has the movable block, the bottom contact of movable block is connected with the installation piece, the inside fixedly connected with probe body of installation piece, the inside of probe shell is provided with telescopic machanism.

Telescopic machanism include with probe shell inner wall fixed connection's motor, the output shaft fixedly connected with screw rod of motor, the inside fixedly connected with fixed plate of probe shell, the outside threaded connection of screw rod has one end to run through and extend to the slide bar of fixed plate bottom, the bottom of slide bar and the top fixed connection of movable block.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, through telescopic machanism, can contract the probe body of installing inside the probe shell for under the condition of external force, the probe body of probe shell inside is not damaged.

Further, the inner wall fixedly connected with quantity of probe shell is the slide rail of two, the outside fixedly connected with quantity of movable block is the slider of two, two the inside of slider and the outside sliding connection of slide rail.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, through two slide rails and slider, can be more steady when the movable block removes, play the help to the collection work of probe body.

Furthermore, the bottom of the movable block is provided with a groove, and an inductor is fixedly connected inside the groove.

By adopting the technical scheme, the biological genes collected by the probe body can be detected through the sensor.

Furthermore, the inner wall of the probe shell is fixedly connected with a sensing device, the bottom of the sensing device is electrically connected with an electric wire, and one side of the electric wire, which is far away from the sensing device, is electrically connected with the top of the inductor.

By adopting the technical scheme, the biogenic data on the detection side of the sensor can be transmitted to the sensing device through the wire.

Furthermore, the top fixedly connected with baffle of fixed plate, the top fixedly connected with mounting panel of probe shell.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, can effectually separate screw rod and electric wire through the baffle.

Furthermore, the bottom of the screw rod is rotatably connected with the top of the fixing plate through a bearing.

Furthermore, the bottom of the probe shell is provided with a through hole matched with the size of the movable block.

Furthermore, the inside of slide bar is seted up with the screw thread through-hole of screw rod size looks adaptation.

Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the application has the following beneficial effects:

this biological gene detection probe is through setting up telescopic machanism for under the effect of motor and screw rod, can stretch out and withdraw the probe body, can withdraw the probe body inside the probe shell after installing the probe body, thereby prevent that the probe body from being damaged by external force, through the motor, can play help to probe body collection work.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of the present invention;

fig. 2 is an enlarged schematic view of a portion a of fig. 1 according to the present invention.

Description of the reference numerals:

1. a slide rail; 2. a slider; 3. a movable block; 4. a fixing plate; 5. an electric wire; 6. a baffle plate; 7. a sensing device; 8. a probe housing; 9. mounting a plate; 10. a motor; 11. a slide bar; 12. a screw; 13. an inductor; 14. mounting blocks; 15. a probe body.

Detailed Description

Referring to fig. 1-2, the bio-gene detection probe in this embodiment includes a probe housing 8, a mounting plate 9 is fixedly connected to the top of the probe housing 8, a sensing device 7 is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the probe housing 8, a wire 5 is electrically connected to the bottom of the sensing device 7, one side of the wire 5 away from the sensing device 7 is electrically connected to the top of an inductor 13, the inner wall of the probe housing 8 is fixedly connected to two sliding rails 1, a movable block 3 is slidably connected to the inside of the probe housing 8, a through hole matched with the size of the movable block 3 is formed in the bottom of the probe housing 8, a groove is formed in the bottom of the movable block 3, the inductor 13 is fixedly connected to the inside of the groove, and the inductor 13 can be any one of the prior art. The outside fixedly connected with quantity of movable block 3 is slider 2 two, the inside of two sliders 2 and the outside sliding connection of slide rail 1, the bottom contact of movable block 3 is connected with installation piece 14, the inside fixedly connected with probe body 15 of installation piece 14, the bottom and the 15 top contact of probe body of inductor 13 are connected, and the sense terminal of inductor 13 and the inside intercommunication of probe body 15, the inside of probe shell 8 is provided with telescopic machanism.

Telescopic machanism include with 8 inner walls of probe shell fixed connection's motor 10, motor 10's output shaft fixedly connected with screw rod 12, the inside fixedly connected with fixed plate 4 of probe shell 8, the bottom of screw rod 12 passes through the bearing rotation with the top of fixed plate 4 to be connected, the top fixedly connected with baffle 6 of fixed plate 4, baffle 6 is located between screw rod 12 and the electric wire 5. The outside threaded connection of screw rod 12 has one end to run through and extend to the slide bar 11 of fixed plate 4 bottom, and the screw thread through-hole with screw rod 12 size looks adaptation is seted up to the inside of slide bar 11, and the bottom of slide bar 11 and the top fixed connection of movable block 3.

It should be noted that, under the action of the motor 10 and the screw 12, the probe body 15 can be extended and retracted, and after the probe body 15 is installed, the probe body 15 can be retracted into the probe shell 8, so that the probe body 15 is prevented from being damaged by external force, and the motor 10 can help the acquisition work of the probe body 15.

Specifically, install probe body 15 into movable block 3 through installation piece 14, through starter motor 10, motor 10 output shaft drives screw rod 12 and rotates, screw rod 12 drives slide bar 11 and removes, thereby will install movable block 3 of probe body 15 and withdraw in probe shell 8, thereby protect probe body 15, prevent that probe body 15 from damaging under the condition of external force, when using, starter motor 10, motor 10 pushes out movable block 3 in probe shell 8, under the direction through two slide rails 1 and two sliders 2, biological gene sampling that carries out that probe body 15 can be steady, detect through the inductor 13 of movable block 3 internally mounted, protect through electric wire 5 again in with data transmission sensing device 7 and preserve.

The working principle of the above embodiment is as follows: install probe body 15 into movable block 3 through installation piece 14, through starter motor 10, motor 10 output shaft drives screw rod 12 and rotates, screw rod 12 drives slide bar 11 and removes, thereby withdraw the movable block 3 of installing probe body 15 into probe shell 8, thereby protect probe body 15, prevent probe body 15 under the condition of external force and damage, when using, starter motor 10, motor 10 pushes out the movable block in probe shell 8, under the direction through two slide rails 1 and two sliders 2, probe body 15 can be steady carries out biological gene sampling, detect through the inductor 13 of movable block 3 internally mounted, protect through electric wire 5 again in with data transmission sensing device 7 and preserve.
